name: Notus NextJS
summary: Free Tailwind CSS and Next.js UI kit with an admin dashboard, 120 components and 18 dynamic components.
description: A free, MIT-licensed UI kit and admin for Tailwind CSS and Next.js. It ships over 120 fully coded components, 18 dynamic Next.js components (navbars, modals, tabs, menus, tooltips, popovers) and prebuilt pages: a dashboard with settings, tables and maps, plus login, register, landing and profile samples.
